Premier League clubs clash over commercial rights and revenue distribution

A dispute has emerged within the English Premier League concerning commercial rights and revenue distribution, involving the "big six" clubs and their rivals. The "big six" are reportedly in opposition to plans that could lead to a significant financial boost for the league. This disagreement centers on how commercial revenues are shared among the participating clubs, with differing proposals on the table.
